description: This Mendeley Data release contains UAV-acquired thermal-fusion and visible images of operating rooftop photovoltaic modules in Dhaka, Bangladesh. The collection used an MLX90640BAB thermal sensor and Raspberry Pi 5 according to the article title, and the repository describes its purpose as automated hotspot detection. Its version 1 inventory lists a large labelled image archive, raw example archive and training-artifact archive under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is rooftop modules in one city, not a representative sample of all PV plant types, climates or maintenance states. Thermal anomalies may have more than one cause, including shading and soiling; an image label alone does not establish electrical fault severity or future energy loss. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is testing image-based condition inputs before modelling degradation or inspection scheduling. data-hong-kong-rooftop-pv-generation-2021-2023 is related operating-output context, but it has no verified image-level pairing with this collection. The archives, annotations and model training artefacts were not downloaded or inspected.
